result.rationale: The Healthy band is well supported: the formula reconciles (0.65 x 12.0 + 0.35 x 0.0 = 7.8), the single open overdue is only 12 DPD, and all eleven matched articles are severity 0, including Q1 net profit up 14% to Rs 4,123 crore and a $1.57bn order win. However, the payment evidence is internally inconsistent — notification N-261112-00003 records INR 83,000,000 owed while the payment review of that same notification states INR 18M — and the reviewer's "exposure is well covered" conclusion was drawn from the smaller figure. The band does not change either way because the formula uses DPD and not the owed amount, but the exposure figure should be reconciled before the verdict is relied on for limit decisions. The reviewer's own caveats on thin history and single-policy visibility also mean this Healthy rating is based on a very short track record.

concerns.issue: Contradictory exposure figures for the same notification: the payment notification records owed of INR 83,000,000, while the payment_review for the identical id N-261112-00003 describes the open overdue as INR 18M. The review's conclusion that exposure is 'well covered' against the 350M credit limit was reached on the 18M figure; at 83M the covered-exposure judgement needs to be re-made. Reconcile before issuing.

The score consumes only DPD (12), not the amount outstanding, so an 83M overdue and an 18M overdue produce the identical 7.8 Healthy result. The band should not be read as a statement about exposure size.

Trend is flagged 'insufficient_history' by the payment agent: only one prior overdue exists (resolved 6 days late) and accumulation is flat at 1 notification in each of the last two 6-month windows, all from a single policy. The current 12 DPD is longer than the prior 6-day-late resolution — a mild deterioration on a two-point record that cannot yet be called a trend.
All notifications originate from a single policy/insurer (TCI-WT-2026-0002), so there is no cross-policy visibility; overdues with other counterparties would not be captured in this Healthy rating.

The article driving the news component has a body identical to its headline, so the severity-0 classification rests on headline text alone. Low impact — ten other severity-0 articles corroborate the benign news picture — but the scored article itself is unverifiable from its content.
